verdict.rationale: Adyen provides a unified Customer Area to manage terminals/transactions and a Management API to order terminals for delivery to specific locations, suggesting some location-level device management. However, there is no explicit documentation of per-location settings customization or per-location reporting/breakdowns for merchant-ops users. missing for 10: explicit per-location reporting dashboards, per-location configuration/settings management, and independent evidence of multi-location fleet operations at scale.
